title: Beauty Salon Interior Design 63 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 63 m² beauty salon: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna — free consultation.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an interior design project for a 63 m² beauty salon, creating a stylish, functional, and comfortable commercial space for both clients and specialists.

The salon layout was planned around its various work areas: stations for hairdressers, manicurists, and brow artists, an esthetician’s treatment room, a reception area, and a staff room. Functional zoning makes it possible to organize workflows efficiently while keeping the interior cohesive.

The project combines contemporary aesthetics with practical solutions for a professional space. Special attention was paid to ergonomics, lighting, storage systems, and the organization of workstations. The interior design project also includes the technical documentation required to implement the interior.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers interior design for beauty salons, hair salons, beauty studios, and other commercial spaces in Bratislava and Vienna. The range of services can include the interior design project, custom furniture, technical documentation, and turnkey renovation — from the initial concept to the finished interior.
